“…Honestly. First Sakura, and now you. You have both been saying the same thing since last night. Have the two of you secretly conspired to make sport of me?”

I don’t even want to think of what’d happen if I did play a joke on her and she found out about it.

It’s good to be able to eat a lot in the morning.

pages.en:
“Uh… well, that's true, but…”

“Besides, who knows when you might attempt another reckless feat like last night's if I left you alone? That was already the second time. There will inevitably be a third. And if that happens, I will have to apologize to Sakura yet again.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Uh, you’re right, but…”
“And I do not know how many more times you will be reckless if I leave you by yourself. It was the second time last night, so the third will certainly happen. I will have to apologize to Sakura again if that happens.”

pages.ja:
「じゃあ」
「まことに不本意ですが、サーヴァントは主の命に従うもの。マスターであるシロウがそう判断したのなら剣は預けます」
pages.jaRuby:
「じゃあ」
「まことに不本意ですが、サーヴァントは主の命に従うもの。マスターであるシロウがそう判断したのなら剣は預けます」
pages.en:
“Then—”

“It is profoundly against my better judgment, but a Servant must obey her lord. If you have made this decision as my Master, Shirou, then my sword is yours.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Then…”
“I am very reluctant, but Servants obey their Masters. I will lend you my sword if that is your decision.”

pages.jaRuby:

セイバー」
「ですがシロウ、あの影は尋常な相手ではない。アレに比べれば、バーサーカーとて御しやすい相手でしょう」
pages.en:
“—Saber.”

“However, Shirou, that shadow is no ordinary opponent. Compared to it, even Berserker would be easy to handle.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Saber.”
“But Shirou, that shadow is no ordinary opponent. It would be easier to fight Berserker than it.”

pages.ja:
「う……ああ、それは肌で感じた。
あいつは、その……強いとか弱いとかいう次元の話じゃなくて、ただ不吉だった。殴れば倒せるって相手でもないと思う」
pages.jaRuby:
「う……ああ、それは肌で感じた。
あいつは、その……強いとか弱いとかいう次元の話じゃなくて、ただ不吉だった。殴れば倒せるって相手でもないと思う」
pages.en:
“Uh… yeah. I felt that for myself.

“It's… not a question of whether that thing is strong or weak. It was simply ominous. I don't think it's the sort of enemy you can defeat by hitting it hard enough.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ugh… Yeah, I felt that too.
It’s not a matter of it being strong or not. That thing is just ominous. I don’t think we can beat it merely by striking it.”

pages.ja:
「それが判っているのなら、私からは何もありません。
……ただ、シロウ。アレの相手をするという事は、最も困難な道を行くということ。それを、今から胸に刻んでおいてください」
pages.jaRuby:
「それが判っているのなら、私からは何もありません。
……ただ、シロウ。アレの相手をするという事は、最も困難な道を行くということ。それを、今から胸に刻んでおいてください」
pages.en:
“If you understand that, I have nothing further to say.

“…But Shirou. To confront that thing is to choose the most difficult path of all. Engrave that upon your heart now.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“If you understand, then there is nothing else to say.
…But Shirou. To oppose that thing is to go down the most difficult path. Please keep that in mind.”

pages.ja: 「……？ いや、そりゃ用心はするけど……なんだよ、ヘンなコト言って。セイバーもアーチャーみたいに、あの影を知ってるのか？」
pages.jaRuby: 「……？ いや、そりゃ用心はするけど……なんだよ、ヘンなコト言って。セイバーもアーチャーみたいに、あの影を知ってるのか？」
pages.en: “…? I mean, I'll be careful, but… why put it like that? Do you know what the shadow is, like Archer does?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “……? Well, of course I’ll be careful. But why are you saying such a thing? Do you know what that shadow is, like Archer does?”

pages.ja: 「……いえ、私もシロウと同じです。あの影が何者なのかは判らない」
pages.jaRuby: 「……いえ、私もシロウと同じです。あの影が何者なのかは判らない」
pages.en: “…No. I am the same as you, Shirou. I do not know what that shadow is.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “…No. Like you, I know nothing about it.”

pages.ja:
視線を逸らす。
セイバーは、まるで自身に湧いた暗い予知を吐露するように、
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
She averts her eyes.

Then Saber speaks as if giving voice to some dark premonition that has taken root within her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Saber looks away.
And Saber says…

pages.ja:
「ただ、漠然と感じたのです。アレは良くない星そのものだと。それこそ関わったもの全てに破滅をもたらす、逃れようのない呪いのような」
そんな事を、言っていた。
pages.jaRuby:
「ただ、漠然と感じたのです。アレは良くない星そのものだと。それこそ関わったもの全てに破滅をもたらす、逃れようのない[ruby text=いばら char=2]呪いのような」
そんな事を、言っていた。
pages.en:
“I merely sensed it, however dimly. That thing is an ill-star made flesh—an inescapable curse of thorns that will bring ruin upon all who become entangled with it.”

That is what she tells me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I vaguely feel that it is the ill star itself. It is like an inescapable curse that destroys everything.”
…As if to express her ominous premonition.
